description: This is an abstract PHP controller class related to file handling in the OrangeHRM system, specifically for managing file responses and setting HTTP headers for file downloads.

classes.name: AbstractFileController
classes.description: Abstract controller providing shared file handling utilities like creating file responses and setting download headers.

methods.name: getNewFileResponse
methods.description: Creates a new BinaryFileResponse object for the given file.

methods.name: getFileResponse
methods.description: Returns a cached or new BinaryFileResponse for the specified file.

methods.name: makeAttachmentDisposition
methods.description: Generates a Content-Disposition header value for attachment download, handling filename encoding.

methods.name: setCommonHeadersToResponse
methods.description: Sets standard HTTP headers on the response related to content type, length, caching, and inline disposition.
